title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft CS → AcademicTermRecord

source_tables.description: Student career term. One row per student per career per term. GPA, units, academic standing, enrollment status.
Student career milestones. Academic standing history, probation, dean's list.
Academic standing definition. Codes and rules for good standing, probation, suspension, dean's list.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map PS standing codes to HELIX: 'GST'→'good_standing', 'PRB'→'probation', 'DMS'→'dismissal', 'DL'→'deans_list', 'PD'→'presidents_list', 'SUS'→'suspension'. Institution-defined in ACAD_STDNG_TBL.
Full-time/part-time classification for the term. Map: 'F'→'full_time', 'H'→'half_time', 'Q'→'three_quarter_time', 'L'→'less_than_half_time'.
Class standing at beginning of term: '10'→'freshman', '20'→'sophomore', '30'→'junior', '40'→'senior'.
true if standing is dean's list, president's list, or honors.

notes: PS_STDNT_CAR_TERM is one of the most queried tables in Campus Solutions. It provides the term-by-term academic transcript view: GPA, credits, standing, and enrollment intensity. Every retention model, IPEDS report, and student success dashboard starts here. Academic standing is evaluated at the end of each term based on institutional rules (GPA thresholds, pace of completion, etc.).
